name: tag2_arc_base
description: Arc-base tag2 Jimu build target from the frontend builder scene.
notes: builder_scene.json is a local copy of /home/zhangzhao/Downloads/jimu_builder_scene_2026-06-02_10_20_46.json.
The cached fixed scene uses the tip-up triangle-tray orientation.

Tray slots are standardized as triangle slots 4, 5, 6, and 12; all other slots are square slots. Tag2 uses triangle spare slot 12 and square spare slot 13. Build layers preserve physical layer order while sorting each layer by tray slot.
The 1mm outward clearance is applied only to first-layer vertical target pieces; upper layers inherit those shifted parent targets.
square_10 has an extra 5mm builder-frame offset away from square_9, and square_11 has an extra 6mm offset away from square_10, to reduce repeated contact in real execution.
The layer_z_extra_m values add cumulative world-Z clearance to every builder layer for real magnetic attachment tolerance; tag2 starts with +4mm on the first layer.
Roof pre-place and low final-contact hover are kept at 10mm because the highest triangle release pose is reachable but the default 20-30mm hover pose has no IK.
Unlocked wall/roof axes are canonicalized so local Y faces outward, and upper-layer targets use design parent poses to avoid cascading dry-run release drift.
